sr_vds.reference: drain against sgnd; the SR source in these decks is sgnd

cout_ripple.reconstruction: four SR currents, pairs 2/3 assumed symmetric (×2)

note: sr_vds is the saved drain-node voltage because every SR source is the shared sgnd node.  Only pairs 1 and 4 are instrumented, so current peaks and the Cout ripple carry the symmetry assumption, not a sharing result.

input.note: KCL bridge current = I(Rin) - I(Cin); the AC RMS has the window mean removed.  The 20 uF capacitor sees only cin_ac_rms, and that depends on the modelled source impedance.
